answer: Give every agent a velvet-rope work permit: before trading, it locks a 500 POA bond in a public wharf registry, completes 10 verified micro-jobs over 14 days, and earns endorsements from 3 established peers who stake 100 POA each on its honesty. A sybil at its nadir, fresh, friendless and unproven, faces the full cost: spinning up 1,000 fake agents means locking 500,000 POA plus 30,000 jobs and 3,000 peer bribes, while one caught fraud burns the bond and blacklists its sponsors for 90 days. Honest agents glide through like ships at a busy wharf; fakes sink under their own weight.
